description: Turn everything measured on the B300 box into the deliverables: a reports/b300-matrix-20260809/ folder matching the shape of reports/h200-tp4-eagle-20260809/, the root README 0.1 Benchmark Reports index updated, corrected scripts/recipes/*.env files that reflect what actually works on B300 (the existing b300-tp2-dp2-fp4-megamoe.env encodes a known-broken shape), and the run ledger updated. This is the only feature that must complete even if the spot instance was interrupted partway: in that case it documents exactly which configs completed and which did not.
steps: Read results/b300-matrix-20260809/matrix-status.json plus every per-config JSON under results/b300-matrix-20260809/ and build the numbers from those artifacts only. Any metric that is not present in an artifact is written as 未评估 with the reason - never a plausible-looking placeholder.

Create reports/b300-matrix-20260809/ with exactly the same file shape as reports/h200-tp4-eagle-20260809/: README.md (Chinese, same section skeleton: 1 测试结论 with the acceptance table and the LMSYS comparison, 2 硬件与软件配置 with 2.1 硬件 and 2.2 软件 tables, then per-config results, then conclusions), plus bench_custom.json / bench_official.json for the primary whole-machine config (c1-tp8-eagle-megamoe) and run_metadata.json.

run_metadata.json must follow the H200 file's key set (run_id, stage, region, instance_id, instance_type, model, sglang_image, tp_size, serve_args, custom_benchmark_file, official_benchmark_file, custom_pass, official_pass, config{input_tokens,output_tokens,official_input_tokens,official_output_tokens,num_prompts,max_concurrency}, elapsed_seconds) with run_id b300-matrix-20260809, instance_id i-0d2500b8c91851a30, instance_type p6-b300.48xlarge, region us-west-2, sglang_image lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.12.post1-cu130, tp_size 8, and add a configs array summarizing all attempted configs since this run covers a matrix rather than a single config.

The report README must contain: (a) a cross-config comparison table with one row per attempted config (c1-c5) showing TPOT P50/P95, TTFT P50/P95, E2E P50, output tok/s, accept length, time-to-healthy, and status; (b) the README 12.9 A1-A9 pass/fail verdict for the whole-machine c1 config, noting that c3 tp=4 and c5 4x-tp2 do not satisfy A6; (c) a B300 vs H200 section against the FEAT-001 baseline numbers (H200 tp=4 EAGLE: custom 40K/1.5K TPOT P50 3.330 ms / TTFT P50 665.1 ms / 224.2 tok/s; official 30K/4096 TPOT P50 3.337 ms / 282.5 tok/s); (d) an EAGLE contribution section from c1 vs c2; (e) a MoE backend section from c1 vs c4; (f) a 已知不可行配置 section recording, with the exact error strings, the unified dp-attention failure (AssertionError: short-circuiting allreduce will lead to hangs), the tp_size % dp_size == 0 assertion, and the B200 dead end (AssertionError: Hidden size mismatch in fused_moe_triton, 4 attempts, both images; plus the FP8 repack ValueError: Downcasting not allowed) so nobody pays to rediscover them; (g) an honest 未完成/受限 section listing any config that did not complete and why, including spot interruption if it happened; (h) cost accounting: wall-clock used times the ~$50/hr spot price.

Update the root README.md section 0.1 Benchmark Reports table (currently one H200 row at line ~36) by appending a B300 row in the same column format (日期 | 硬件 | 配置 | TPOT P50 | Output tok/s | 结果 | 报告) linking to reports/b300-matrix-20260809/. Do not restructure the table or touch other README sections.

Fix scripts/recipes/b300-tp2-dp2-fp4-megamoe.env: it currently exports TP_SIZE=4 with --dp 2 --enable-dp-attention, which is the exact shape proven to fail. Either rewrite it into the verified working shape or replace it with correctly named recipes. Deliver scripts/recipes/b300-tp8-fp4-eagle-megamoe.env as the verified whole-machine recipe (TP_SIZE=8, SGLANG_IMAGE=lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.12.post1-cu130, SGLANG_EXTRA_ARGS with --moe-a2a-backend megamoe --cuda-graph-max-bs 64 --trust-remote-code --enable-metrics and the EAGLE 3/1/4 flags, SGLANG_ENV_VARS=SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=8320, MEM_FRACTION_STATIC=0.85, SERVER_READY_TIMEOUT=2400, and the BENCH_* variables matching the other recipe files), and scripts/recipes/b300-tp8-fp4-nospec.env for the no-EAGLE variant. Follow the heavily-commented style of scripts/recipes/h200-tp4-fp4-eagle.env, and in the comments cite the measured evidence from this run rather than upstream speculation. Any recipe encoding a shape that failed must say so in its header and must not be presented as runnable.

Append an entry per attempted config to results/stage-ledger.json using the existing schema tpot-bench-stage-ledger/2 field set (stage, run_id, instance_type, instance_id, started_at, ended_at, exit_status, s3_prefix, recipe, mode, note, gpu_family, gpu_success, final_phase, spot_price_usd_per_hour, summary_required, summary_done, summary_path, summary_ack) with gpu_family b300 and spot_price_usd_per_hour set from the actual spot price (~50). Update updated_at. Keep the JSON valid.

Optional and strictly last, only after all GPU benchmarking is finished so it cannot perturb latency measurements: run scripts/mirror-checkpoint.sh to mirror the 159.6 GB checkpoint from /opt/dlami/nvme to s3://tpot-bench-results-077090643075-us-west-2/checkpoints/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash/ so a future us-west-2 attempt skips the download, and record in the report whether the mirror completed. Skip it if the box is already gone.
Verify tests/run-tests.sh is still green and commit everything to harden-ec2-bench-runner. Do not push and do not open a PR.
acceptance_criteria: reports/b300-matrix-20260809/ contains README.md, bench_custom.json, bench_official.json and run_metadata.json, and run_metadata.json parses as valid JSON with the same key set as reports/h200-tp4-eagle-20260809/run_metadata.json plus a configs array

The report README contains the cross-config comparison table, the A1-A9 verdict for c1, the B300 vs H200 comparison, the EAGLE contribution comparison, the MoE backend comparison, the 已知不可行配置 section with the exact error strings, an honest unfinished/limited section, and cost accounting
Every number in the report is traceable to a file under results/b300-matrix-20260809/; anything unmeasured is marked 未评估 with a reason
README.md section 0.1 has a new B300 row linking to reports/b300-matrix-20260809/ and the existing H200 row is unchanged

scripts/recipes/b300-tp2-dp2-fp4-megamoe.env no longer presents the failing --dp 2 --enable-dp-attention shape as runnable, and scripts/recipes/b300-tp8-fp4-eagle-megamoe.env plus scripts/recipes/b300-tp8-fp4-nospec.env exist and are valid bash (bash -n clean)
results/stage-ledger.json is valid JSON with one new entry per attempted config and an updated updated_at
tests/run-tests.sh passes with at least 22 cases and at least 220 assertions
Everything is committed to harden-ec2-bench-runner and nothing is pushed
verification: for f in scripts/recipes/b300-*.env; do bash -n $f; done
grep -n 'b300-matrix-20260809' README.md confirms the index row exists

diff <(python3 -c 'import json;print(sorted(json.load(open("reports/h200-tp4-eagle-20260809/run_metadata.json")).keys()))') <(python3 -c 'import json;print(sorted(k for k in json.load(open("reports/b300-matrix-20260809/run_metadata.json")) if k!="configs"))')
git status --short shows a clean tree after commit and git log --oneline -1 is on harden-ec2-bench-runner
